Why Attend? 1. Expand your network—Meet leading VCs, founders & builders from APAC & US 2. Discover new market opportunities—Insights into the Web3 expansion in Asia & the US 3. Collaborate & scale—Explore funding, partnerships & strategic growth 4. Join exclusive discussions—Learn from Web3 pioneers building across regions Agenda Highlights: - Opening Remarks – Meet the organizers & sponsors - US & APAC Web3 Market Overview – Understanding the opportunities in both regions - Founder Roundtable – Navigating challenges, scaling strategies & funding - Open Networking – Forge meaningful connections with Web3 leaders 📌 Secure your spot now! Limited capacity, register today: https://lu.ma/ulm5bpeb We can’t wait to welcome you to ETH Denver’s premier international Web3 gathering! See you there!
